tripAdvisorReviews.name: hub by Premier Inn London Westminster Abbey hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: 21 Tothill Street Westminster, London SW1H 9LL England

reviews.title: Absolutely Brilliant
reviews.text:
The hotel was absolutely brilliant 
- brilliant room 
- good storage 
- good size bed
- good tv 
- lovely bathroom 
- good heating system
- so central to big sights 
- brilliant cafe called cafe fresco beside it for breakfast 
- free tea and coffee
- free bag holding 
- staff were so helpful

reviews.title: Great sleep, poor breakfast experience.
reviews.text: I'd stayed here before and was looking forward to staying again. The hotel is super clean and comfortable with fast, free wifi and an efficient check in and out service. The breakfast next day spoiled it as I was forced to sit at a communal table on a hard chair when there were plenty of empty small tables with comfortable chairs. I asked if I could sit at a table and was told no, they're not for people on their own. The waitress was polite and clearly rushed right off her feet so I didn't really pursue it. Lots of tables weren't cleared and she had to take plates from the communal table so I could sit there, but she didn't have time to wipe it so it wasn't ideal.

reviews.title: Great for a short solo trip!
reviews.text:
Great location, within walking distance to many of London’s well known tourist sites. 

Perfect set up for solo travel. Plenty of underbed storage with around 5 hangers to hang up items in the open wardrobe. 

Next door to cafes and within a 5 minute walk of a convenience store. Within 10 minutes walk of a pharmacist. 

Easy travel to other parts of the city from either St James’s Park or Westminster Stations. I felt confident navigating back to the hotel due to its proximity to Big Ben and Westminster Abbey. 

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay!!!

reviews.title: Fab
reviews.text:
This hotel was simpy fab.  Friendly staff, very helpful.  Andrea B was particularly lovely.
The breakfast was excellent value and all cooked fresh.
The rooms were spotless.  They were small but had everything we needed.  
This hotel in particular was in a great loaction and we were able to walk to all the attractions we had booked.
There are a few Hubs in central London so make sure you travel to the correct one - we did a bit of unecessary back and forward on day one but this was purely our fault.

reviews.title: Location and quiet
reviews.text: The location of this hotel was excellent for me. The corridors and rooms are very quiet but i do feel the air-conditioning in the rooms could be upgraded. I would have preferred a window to open to let in some fresh air. Breakfast is good value for money. The complimentary tea & coffee in the lounge rather than in the room took a minute to accept but its good quality which make sup for the inconvenience of going downstairs.
